changed: The plugin boundary is locked and declared capability requirements are enforced (XA-02, XA-03, R-7), in 79978a1. pyproject.toml gains two import-linter contracts: 'Core never imports plugins' (sources e_agent.contracts, e_agent.sdk, e_agent.kernel, e_agent.server; forbidden e_agent.erp, e_agent.adapters.odoo, e_agent.plugins.erp.simulator), which replaces the kernel-only 'Kernel never imports domains or server' (kernel -> server stays forbidden by the layers contract), and 'Plugins are guests' (sources the three plugin packages; forbidden e_agent.kernel, e_agent.server, e_agent.adapters.postgres, e_agent.adapters.secretstore_local, e_agent.adapters.pydantic_ai, e_agent.adapters.shacl); the per-plugin contracts stay. lint-imports keeps all 12 contracts; with the plan's temporary probes (from e_agent.erp import plugin in bootstrap.py, import e_agent.adapters.postgres in the simulator's plugin.py) both new contracts reported BROKEN, and both files were restored. PluginRegistry.register() refuses with STARTUP_REJECTED a binding template whose supported_features lack any of its contract's required_features, whether or not a connection is assigned; the message names the plugin, the binding, the contract and the sorted missing features. The proposals.py _handle_answer docstring drops the ERP task ids, and the demo help text in server/cli.py drops 'procurement'. New tests: tests/conformance/test_plugin_guests.py (test_every_plugin_package_is_a_guest derives the packages from the installed e_agent.plugins.v1 entry points, 3 today, and reads the contract's source_modules from pyproject.toml; test_guest_check_fails_on_zero_plugins; test_guest_check_reports_an_unlisted_plugin), tests/unit/kernel/test_registry.py (test_binding_missing_required_feature_refused, test_binding_missing_required_feature_refused_without_a_connection, test_binding_with_required_features_admitted), tests/unit/server/test_generic_composition.py (test_notes_pack_composes_through_bootstrap installs the kernel conftest's notes pack as a discovered distribution in tmp_path and, in a subprocess, composes it with build_runtime, records read.recorded and reaches WAITING_APPROVAL with no e_agent.erp, e_agent.adapters.odoo or e_agent.plugins.erp module in sys.modules; test_server_has_no_domain_literals scans the 7 server sources case-insensitively for demand:, product:, odoo, erp and procure, prints the count and fails on zero; test_capabilities_without_requirements_unchanged pins the fixture profile's admission: domain-erp and fixture-erp admitted, odoo19 skipped, 17 bindings equal to the profile's, 21 capabilities). Red first: the guest test (no such contract), both feature-refusal tests (DID NOT RAISE) and the literal test (cli.py:225 'procurement') failed before the change; the composition, admitted-with-features and unchanged-admission tests passed on the existing tree, which the plan expects for them. The OpenAPI check exits 0, so the API is unchanged.
